text: くッ…　そんな　おおぜいで　ひきょうだぞ

structure.jp: そんな　おおぜいで

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a word for a number of people says how many do the thing together. そんな おおぜいで = 'in a crowd that big'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, forceful way to drive a point home or warn someone. ひきょうだぞ = 'that's cowardly, you hear!'.
